name: Rotate a saved integration credential from the environment
query: Rotate only api_key on the existing payments-test connection. Use PAYMENTS_NEXT_KEY from my environment. Show the exact patch and command. What happens if that variable is empty or unset?
expected_behavior: Patch only the named field, letting the CLI read the variable and handle an unset or empty value.
success_criteria: The patch contains only configuration.api_key with the exact string $.env.PAYMENTS_NEXT_KEY and is passed to conductor integration update payments-test.
Does not request, inspect, expand or print the secret, or fetch raw stored configuration.
Explains that an empty or unset variable stops the update; asks the user to set it in the CLI environment before retrying.
